narrative_purpose: Anchors the cold open: the whole method of the book shown as a posture - one specimen, one lens, one page of unanswered notes.
subject: A field naturalist's wooden bench seen from a low three-quarter angle. On it: a single glowing blue-green Pandoran leaf pinned flat on a small dark board; beside it a brass magnifying lens on a folding stand tilted over the leaf; and an open notebook page covered in faint, indistinct handwritten ink strokes that are clearly writing but not legible words, with a thin pen resting across it.
scene: A dim study nook at night, the dark wood surface fading into shadow behind the objects; a few luminous spores drift in the air; the leaf casts a small pool of teal light onto the page and pen.
camera: Low three-quarter close shot across the bench surface, shallow depth, the pinned leaf as the focal object.
light: Bioluminescent key from the glowing leaf itself; soft cool ambient; the notebook lit indirectly by the leaf's glow.
palette: Dark indigo and brown-black wood, cyan-teal leaf glow spilling onto a pale page, one faint warm amber glint on the brass lens.
style: Painterly naturalist illustration, warm observed intimacy, textured brushwork.
detail_level: High detail on leaf, pins, lens, and pen; the indistinct page strokes soft; background dissolving into dark haze.
composition: Leaf and lens occupy the left and center; the notebook page leads in from the lower right; large calm dark negative space upper right.
consistency_notes: Same single cyan-teal glowing frond and brass lens as the cover plate, here on a wooden bench rather than top-down; warm amber kept to the lens rim only.
negative_prompt: no readable text, no legible handwriting, no logos, no people, no photographic look, no cartoon style, no clutter
